title: cli: os migrate apply's pre-prompt listing omits the permission-set grant guard its flush then builds
body:
domain:server#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcSZ51q2s3nMfakhdJ3

Filing gate: ② a declared contract that the code does not honour. Reported by the #32460 dev (report on #32460; PR #32650), and filed by the seat. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade and the lane.
Seam: docs `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` ("everything apply is about to do — additive work included — is on screen before the [y/N] prompt") → runtime: `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/apply.ts` pre-prompt render | consumer: operator
reach: named producer. `os migrate apply` renders `renderPendingSchemaWork` and `renderPlan` before `[y/N]` (`apply.ts:376-377` on `origin/main`). After the confirmation, its flush announces the schema-sync pass, and that pass builds `uniq_sys_user_permission_set_packageless`, which is never on screen before the prompt.

## Expected

Apply's pre-prompt listing shows the same schema-sync index step that `os migrate plan` lists once PR #32650 lands, so the prompt covers every DDL apply then runs. PR #32650 adds `collectSchemaSyncIndexes` / `renderSchemaSyncIndexes` in `packages/cli/src/utils/schema-sync-indexes.ts`, so the dev measured the fix at about two calls.

## Business reason

Operators who answer the `[y/N]` prompt. Today that prompt under-reports one DDL on the grant table that the apply then runs.

## Reader

The `domain:server` seat, once PR #32650 has landed.

Blocked-by: #32460

## Duplicate check

- `is:issue migrate apply prompt runtime-owned index` → 10 hits. The open ones are #32460 (the plan half, in flight) and the seat posts #6015, #12708 and #6017.
- `is:issue schemaSyncIndexes apply` → 1 hit, #32460.
- `is:issue uniq_sys_user_permission_set_packageless apply` → 2 hits, #32460 and #32164.

None tracks apply's pre-prompt listing.
